investment_strategy: Focus on a diversified, AI-centric large-cap portfolio tilted toward lower-volatility, high-quality compounders with strong growth and positive analyst support. Given a relatively elevated but not extreme VIX (~20) and a 10Y yield above 4%, the strategy avoids over-concentration in the highest-volatility names and instead builds a core around mega-cap platform and infrastructure leaders with consistent earnings beats and reasonable valuations. Satellite positions in select infrastructure and enterprise AI beneficiaries are added for upside, while highly speculative, structurally declining, or execution-risk-heavy names receive no allocation.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Flagship AI platform with deep integration of GPT-4/ChatGPT across products, heavy AI and nuclear-backed data center investment, and dominant enterprise AI positioning. Repeatedly highlighted as central to AI race and corporate AI spending.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Core anchor position reflecting top-tier quality, diversified revenue streams, strong earnings/revenue growth, and STRONG_BUY consensus. Moderate volatility and reasonable valuation justify a relatively high weight even amid a mildly cautious macro backdrop.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Major AI infrastructure and tools provider with prominent coverage in AI tools, search, robotics (RT-2), and regulatory debates. A core hyperscaler funding AI infrastructure and at the center of policy discussions.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Second core pillar, balancing strong AI upside, robust fundamentals, and reasonable risk. Slightly higher P/E than MSFT and regulatory overhang warrant a modestly smaller but still significant allocation.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Key player in making AI mainstream via Apple Intelligence and AI-enhanced iPhones; strong narrative as the mobile AI interface and competitive counterweight to other big tech.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: High-quality, large-cap growth with strong momentum and manageable risk. Valuation is higher and direct AI monetization is earlier-stage than MSFT/GOOGL, so allocation is slightly lower but still core.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Positioned as an enterprise AI and hybrid cloud provider with legal indemnification and transparent training data, appealing to regulated industries and cautious adopters. Narrative emphasizes trust and compliance in AI.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Lower-beta, income- and value-leaning AI beneficiary that diversifies away from high-beta mega-cap tech. Strong earnings growth and ATTRACTIVE assessment justify a meaningful but not dominant position.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Critical networking and data-center gear for AI buildout; news highlights cost discipline (layoffs) and its role in the broader cloud/AI infrastructure stack.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Attractive, relatively lower-vol infrastructure play with solid growth, good momentum, and manageable volatility. Provides diversification versus pure software/platform exposure.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Key open-source LLM provider deploying AI assistants and chatbots across its massive social platforms, with heavy AI capex and central role in AI safety and monetization debates.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: High-upside, higher-volatility growth engine in social + AI. Strong fundamentals and STRONG_BUY consensus warrant inclusion, but macro uncertainty and capex cyclicality constrain allocation size.
